slides.text: A FAKE CANCER 'DOCTOR' TURNED THIS HOTEL INTO A HOSPITAL
Eureka Springs, Arkansas. The Crescent Hotel opened in 1886, a luxury resort in the Ozark mountains.
Legend says an Irish stonemason called 'Michael' fell to his death while it was being built.
1937: Norman Baker bought it. He had no medical license. He opened the 'Baker Cancer Hospital'.
He promised a cure without surgery. Desperate patients came from all over the country.
There was no cure. In 1940 Baker went to federal prison for mail fraud.
The basement he used as a morgue is still there.
Today it's a hotel again, with nightly ghost tours. Staff say Michael's favorite room is 218.
